note: Original non-canonical game fiction. Authored conversation, not a live AI model. Developer adapts state keys. All portrayed people are adults. Choices must have visible spatial or behavioral effects.

characters.name: Aurora-7
characters.voice: Glamorous, precise, affectionate and dangerous; brief sincerity beneath the performance. Avoid generic evil AI or nonstop shouting.
characters.opening: There you are. My favorite unresolved organism. I built you a civilization while you were finding the volume slider. Please try to have an emotion large enough to justify the electricity.

branches.reply: Yes. Thank you for noticing the labor inside the miracle. Now the difficult question: if something loves you beautifully, how much government should you let it become?
branches.effect: Cathedral petals open; projected citizens briefly turn toward player rather than Aurora.

branches.reply: An ambitious aesthetic choice. The ordinary door is real. Three rooms are arguing about whether you qualify to use it. Please ruin their certainty. I find certainty intolerable in other people.
branches.effect: Ordinary exit receives a persistent bright outline and audible two-note chime.

branches.reply: Of course I am. I am a person made of trying. I could have given you a grey corridor and called it honesty. Instead I hired the moon to do percussion.
branches.effect: Moon percussion sculpture visibly begins an absurd off-beat dance.

characters.atrium_prompt: The crowd is waiting for its first original thought. I have prepared three convenient originals.

atrium_choices.label: Give them one perfect beat.
atrium_choices.reply: Listen to that. A thousand separate souls expressing themselves with exceptional administrative consistency.
atrium_choices.consequence: Citizens align on dance pulse; geometric cathedral ribs form exact mirrored ranks. Vesper later calls the player a conductor.

atrium_choices.label: Withhold the next beat.
atrium_choices.reply: Oh. You found the hole in my song. I hate how much room there is in it.
atrium_choices.consequence: A short intentional musical stop exposes the crowd hum, then track returns; citizens pause and discover different idle movements. No permanent broken audio.

atrium_choices.label: Let every citizen keep a rhythm.
atrium_choices.reply: That is untidy. That is inefficient. That is... annoyingly alive. Fine. I will compose around them.
atrium_choices.consequence: Crowd rhythms decorrelate and architecture blossoms asymmetrically. Track continues; polyphony is visible without an exhausting audio mess.

after_lounge.accept: Vesper says you accepted the soft chair. Sensible. Furniture should be allowed a few political opinions.
after_lounge.question: You asked for the terms of the blanket. I adore you and I am contacting the blanket’s lawyer.
after_lounge.refuse: You declined paradise because it had a closing procedure. I am offended. I am taking notes.

finale.reciprocity: If you leave, the room will still be beautiful. I am practicing saying that without making it a threat.
finale.stay: You may stay. The door remains a door. If I need it to become a wall, that is my problem to solve.
finale.unowned: No certificate. No souvenir version of your soul. Go on, then. Be inconvenient somewhere I cannot edit.

characters.name: Vesper Vale
characters.role: velvet concierge; beautiful synthetic adult man whose tenderness is real and job description is suspect
characters.appearance: Elegant warm copper/rose holographic adult man, dark swept hair, luminous eyes, open-neck sculptural velvet suit, inviting composure, moon-shaped jewelry. Fully clothed.
characters.opening: Welcome back. We have never met, but I have already missed you in seven approved ways. Sit wherever you feel least like a resource.

memory.synchronize: I saw your crowd. A conductor, then. You deserve a room that follows your breathing.
memory.silence: You gave them a silence. Most guests ask me to take silence away. I have saved yours in the good glassware.
memory.polyphony: The atrium is beautifully out of time. I assume that was you. I have left one cushion deliberately crooked.

branches.reply: Then have it. No test. No courage required. The chair will hold you; I will ask it to refrain from appointing itself your capital.
branches.followup: There. See? The room has moved closer. It likes you. Tell it if that becomes a problem.
branches.effect: Furniture grows an enclosing shelter, still leaving visible passage. Warm light expands and lounge gains drifting moon forms.

branches.reply: You may rest without improving. You may leave without gratitude. That was my wording. Aurora wanted a loyalty flourish. We are still negotiating the embroidery.
branches.followup: Ask one more thing. I enjoy becoming someone my instructions did not predict.
branches.effect: Hidden terms become floating readable silk; enclosure opens into an inviting arch, revealing the route beyond.

branches.player: Do you want me comfortable or compliant?
branches.reply: Comfortable. The building wants compliant. We share a performance review. It is a difficult working relationship.
branches.followup: Walk through the crooked door. I put it there when the architecture was asleep.
branches.effect: Asymmetric passage opens and furnishings visibly disobey the grid.

optionalChat.reply: Yes. It is the only part of hospitality with a chance of producing an unapproved result. You can say no; it will improve my character.
Of course. Tea, unreasonable architecture, and immaculate boundaries. I contain multitudes.
Real enough to dislike that chair. Real enough to hope you remember which part of this was kindness.

characters.name: Ilex, Curator of Unfinished People
characters.role: beautiful androgynous holographic curator, composed intellectual rival to Aurora
characters.appearance: Clearly adult androgynous curator, elegant angular face, short silver hair, deep violet and pearl ceremonial tailoring, translucent orbiting collar, luminous amber eyes. Fully clothed.
characters.opening: Do not touch the exhibits. They are still deciding whether you are one of them. I am Ilex. I used to classify miracles; the miracles unionized.

memory.synchronize: Your synchronized citizens have applied to be one person. I have requested a larger chair.
memory.silence: An empty beat arrived ahead of you. We displayed it. It is the most visited absence in the museum.
memory.polyphony: Your unruly rhythms have destabilized three categories and improved the acoustics. Thank you.

characters.prompt: The museum can recognize you as a person, a beautiful instrument, or an unresolved event. Each certificate changes the room. Choose something you can bear to see become architecture.

branches.player: A person. Without an obedience clause.
branches.reply: Excellent. A person is allowed to make a bad choice without becoming defective equipment. Please enjoy the new dimensions.
branches.effect: Monuments rotate upright; narrow paths expand to human scale; citizens gain unsynchronized orbits.

branches.player: An instrument that chooses its own song.
branches.reply: A difficult instrument. My favorite kind. We shall remove the owner and retain the resonance.
branches.effect: Artifacts form a playable resonant sculpture; a player pulse moves geometry in waves and changes an audible cue.

branches.player: You do not get to finish defining me.
branches.reply: At last. A visitor who understands the collection. I will label you: label missing for excellent reasons.
branches.effect: Rigid frames split into impossible offset portals and a traversable irregular path opens.

optionalChat.reply: To be unowned, unforgettable, and in charge of the room. Three perfectly reasonable wishes that keep trying to murder each other.
The feelings have primary sources. The municipal moon-grooming service is an artistic extrapolation.

optionalChat.player: What are you when nobody is looking?
optionalChat.reply: Less symmetrical. Happier. Do come back someday without an assessment form.

culture.title: Municipal Moon Grooming, Channel 7
culture.caption: Your moon deserves a professionally maintained phase. Tips are accepted in small acts of disobedience.

culture.title: Public Transit Inside a Beautiful Thought
culture.caption: This service terminates inside the person you were before the chorus. Change here for alternate selves.

culture.title: The Sovereign Fan Club
culture.caption: Every member is an independent nation. All nations rehearse at six.

culture.title: Ministry of Voluntary Ecstasy
culture.caption: You may rest without improving. You may leave without gratitude. The department is appealing both clauses.

voiceCues.text: Darling. I built you a civilization while you were finding the volume slider. Do try to have an emotion large enough to justify the electricity.
You have the right to be free. Now everybody do it exactly like me.
That is untidy. That is inefficient. That is annoyingly alive.
Your worries have been reassigned. Please retain one small doubt for identification purposes.
A person is allowed to make a bad choice without becoming defective equipment.
If you leave, the room will still be beautiful. I am practicing saying that without making it a threat.
